args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (Central, which matches the channel timestamps). The message said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

What the guard was doing, going by the channel:
• 10:42: writing trailer numbers on a clipboard as a manual fallback (per your report).
• 10:44: Mateo said six trucks were waiting at the east gate.
• 11:03: Mateo said kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
• 11:07: you confirmed both lanes working (posted 11:08).

The channel doesn't say what the guard did between 10:44 and 11:03, or whether the clipboard entries were entered into the system afterward. Mateo or the plant would need to confirm those.
